root_idea.summary: The root centers on lowering, bringing down, or making less, in contrast with raising; it extends to humility, gentleness, quietness, ease, and abasement.
root_idea.development: Concrete lowering develops into figurative lowering of rank or status, gentle and submissive conduct, reduced intensity or abundance, and states of ease or repose.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form I verb, normalized from the imperative QAC lemma to the perfect citation form.
Quran-attested active participle, presented under the masculine singular citation form.

senses.definition: To lower one's wing: to adopt a gentle, humble, and yielding manner toward another.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, this is the figurative جناح construction, expressing gentleness or submissive kindness toward believers or parents, rather than merely physical lowering.

senses.definition: One that brings down or abases; in the Quranic description of the Resurrection, that which lowers some people while others are raised.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrence is the feminine form خَافِضَةٌ in the paired expression خَافِضَةٌ رَافِعَةٌ, interpreted as lowering the disobedient or placing some people in a lower fate or rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower or depress a thing, opposite to raising it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A direct transitive use for physically bringing an object down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abase or lower a person's standing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested figuratively of lowering an unbeliever or another person in rank or status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to lower, relax, or contract its wing against its side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a bird settling or ceasing from flight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To diminish a share or the means of subsistence; figuratively, for justice or the just party to be brought low or overcome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence includes uses concerning the portion allotted to a person and the changing relation of justice and injustice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make travel proceed at a gentle pace; of camels or a land, to go or cause movement gently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive travel example is qualified in the source and is contrasted with a vehement or raised pace; another interpretation takes it as going down or up.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower one's voice or refrain from raising it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use, opposite to raising the voice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of life or circumstances, to be or become easy, tranquil, plentiful, and free from hardship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing a pleasant or undemanding condition of life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, or abide in a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِالمكانِ for staying in a location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An archaic intransitive use, said of a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To circumcise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence especially applies the verb to circumcising a girl, while also recording a use for circumcising a boy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw or bring down a camel's head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used to lower the camel's head toward the ground so that it may be mounted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To weaken or lower a person's state or rank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative figurative use concerning condition or status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To calm or tranquillize a person or heart, or make an affair light and easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the constructions خَفِّضْ عَلَيْكَ جَاشَكَ and خَفِّضْ عَلَيْكَ الأَمْرَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make speech gentle or soft.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative use applied to one's words or manner of speaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring death near or leave someone with no escape from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested figuratively of afflictions that bring a person close to death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become low, lowered, or depressed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form VII development of the lowering sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become circumcised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded specifically of a girl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ease, repose, tranquillity, quietness, and freedom from hardship; also abundance and pleasantness of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a noun for an easy or plentiful condition of life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gentleness or softness of voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun use describing a low, gentle quality of speech or voice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gentle pace, opposite to a raised or vehement pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of movement, especially the pace of camels or travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low or depressed land, including a hollow or sunken tract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical use contrasted with hard or elevated land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of abasement or being brought low.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the paired expression contrasting a state of lowering with a state of elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, soft, or gentle in voice or speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to a voice or words.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy, tranquil, plentiful, or pleasant in respect of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to life or its circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Abaser: one of the divine names, meaning the one who abases the proud or anything He wills to abase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A theological epithet derived from the active-participle sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who lowers an age designation in the assessment of livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use in which an assessor assigns a lower age category to an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gentle, compliant, submissive, grave, or calm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used in the idiom خَافِضُ الجَنَاحِ, describing a person of yielding and composed manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, soft, or gentle in voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in describing a woman who is not clamorous or foul-tongued.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy to irrigate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of land that is easy of irrigation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy or gentle in journeying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a night or route that permits easy travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Remaining at a watering place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a people or company staying at water rather than ranging in search of pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who circumcises girls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related masculine active-participle form may be applied to a man who circumcises boys.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where people are in ease, tranquillity, or plentiful and pleasant circumstances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun describing the setting in which a group enjoys ease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anatomical place where a girl's circumcision is performed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl who has been circumcised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial technical use.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Reduction of a share and figurative defeat of justice.
Calming and making an affair easy.
Making an affair light or easy.
Noun senses of life ease and voice gentleness.
Explicit Quranic interpretation of خافضة رافعة.
Woman with a low or gentle voice.
Pointer to an already represented noun sense.
Phonetic classification of letters, not a general lexical sense.

cautions: The three Quranic occurrences of the Form I verb are imperatives in lowering-wing constructions; the broader physical, status, voice, and other meanings listed separately are Classical Arabic evidence, not additional Quranic verb senses.
The Quranic active-participle occurrence is feminine خَافِضَةٌ and is presented under the normalized masculine singular citation form خَافِضٌ.
The Lane travel example under خَفَضَ is explicitly qualified and has an alternative interpretation involving descent or ascent.
